Attackdown_boss_hum_057_Fentan_10_1_des: Cannot be healed, this effect cannot be removed by other effects.
Dianming_boss_hum_057_Juedou_8_1_des: When located within a certain range in front of Zhuyan, increase shatter by <shuzhi>400%</> and reduce damage received by <shuzhi>30%</>.
Buff_boss_066_Player_Shield_-1_1_des: Energy shield obtained after absorbing dissipated energy orbs. For a short time, immune to damage when taking damage.
Stun_boss_hum_057_Fentan_2_1_des: Cannot take any actions when panicked.
Buff_boss_hum_019_5_ice_des: The Wanderer will receive DoT when frostbitten inside the Coldfrost Zone. The longer they stay in the Coldfrost Zone, the higher the frostbite damage will be.
Buff_boss_hum_020_2_des: When the countdown ends, a 0.5-second penalty check will be activated. During the penalty check, any actions such as moving, jumping, crouching, taking damage, or using skills will cause damage equal to 50% of the Wanderer's Max HP.
Buff_Boss_065_4_frozen_des: Merbelle's damage gains Flashfreeze. When Flashfreeze stacks 15 times, this unit is greatly Phantasia Slowed.
Buff_boss_065_3_onArmorOpen_des: When Merbelle has a shield, gain additional damage reduction and greatly increase shield strength.
Buff_Boss_065_2_des: Whenever Merbelle loses a certain amount of HP, its attack will increase.
Buff_boss_006_02_NeuralToxin_des: Stuns for 15s upon reaching 15 Neural Toxin stacks. Collect randomly spawned antidotes to remove all stacks.
Buff_boss_002_5_ignore_des: During the duration, the Wanderer's hyperbody is disabled, and cannot enter an invincible state.
Buff_boss_010_4_punishment_des: Unable to gain hyperbody or invincibility.
Buff_boss_014_5_des: Wanderers cannot grant hyperbody state to themselves.
Buff_boss_012_5_corrosion_des: Whenever dealing damage, the Singer inflicts a stack of Corrosion. Targets with 20 stacks of Corrosion will be weakened.
Buff_boss_065_4_frozen20_des: This unit is Phantasia Slowed by the Flashfreeze effect.
Buff_boss_046_02_Weak_des: Increases damage taken by 3% per hit, up to 10 stacks for 5s.
Buff_boss_hum_025_2_damage_des: Deals 5% Max HP damage per second for 15s, up to 1 stack.
Buff_boss_042_5_des: The shockwave released by Gaia after its shield is shattered will inflict Weakness on hit units, increasing their final damage taken. Stacks up to 3 times.
Delay_3s_boss_hum_057_1_3_des: Shock nearby teammates at the end.
Buff_boss_042_4_des: Units hit by Gaia will be inflicted with this effect.
Buff_boss_hum_020_5_des: Wanderers affected by this effect will transfer a portion of the damage they receive from the boss to allies suffering from the same effect. The amount of damage transferred is based on the damage dealt by the boss to that Wanderer.
Buff_boss_002_4_des: The healing applied by the Wanderer will be converted into an equivalent amount of damage.
Buff_boss_hum_020_4_des: Receive a large amount of damage every second, lasting for 15 seconds.
Buff_boss_010_4_punish_des: After Seraph hits a non-Fortitude target, Punishments will be added. Punishments will be reduced by 1 stack every 5 seconds. If Punishment stacks reach 10, that Wanderer will lose their hyperbody and invincibility and will be unable to regain hyperbody or invincibility for 90 seconds.
Buff_boss_042_2_suigu20_des: Reduce final damage by 50% for 10 seconds.
Buff_boss_012_5_weak_des: Reduces ATK and movement speed (Phantasia Slow)
Buff_boss_042_2_suigu_des: When a target without Fortitude is hit by Gaia, they will be inflicted with Bonecrush. Upon 20 stacks of Bonecrush, the target will be Crippled.
Breakfate_Boss_01_desc: It was originally an advanced aberrant but was later modified by Dr. Burkman with ATK boosting devices added to it. However, it became more violent and hard to control after the modification and was thus abandoned.
Breakfate_Boss_02_desc: A humanlike Mecha made by the Ravagers from an old aircraft with a Gatling gun on its left wrist and an electromagnetic cutting weapon on its right wrist. It can temporarily hover in the air.
Breakfate_Boss_03_desc: The Hyenas invented a simple yet fairly powerful Mecha a with the limited resources they had on hand. The cannons on its shoulders are capable of suppressive fire and bombardment at the same time. And the cooling devices on its arms emit steam that can be used to attack enemies during combat.
Buff_boss_hum_042_3_suigu_des: After 5 seconds of Blast Mark, it will detonate, dealing lethal damage 5 times to ally units surrounding the marked target 1 time every second.
Buff_boss_hum_042_5_des: The shockwave released by Gaia after its shield is shattered will inflict Weakness on hit units, lowering their final damage. Stacks up to 3 times.
Buff_boss_hum_042_4_speedDown_des: Units hit by Gaia will be inflicted with this effect.
Buff_boss_hum_042_2_suigu20_des: Reduce final damage by 50% for 10 seconds.
Buff_boss_hum_042_2_suigu_des: When a target without Fortitude is hit by Gaia, they will be inflicted with Bonecrush. Upon 20 stacks of Bonecrush, the target will be Crippled.
Boss_hum_046_3_des: The lower the boss's HP, the greater its damage reduction. The boss can then be executed. Use weapons with high shatter to break its shield and execute it. Execution damage ignores the boss's damage reduction and is affected by the Wanderer's ATK, resistance, and damage boost.
Boss_hum_020_5_des: Sweetie chains all Wanderer-allied targets on the field. Each target will suffer damage proportional to the percentage of damage received by other chained targets.
Boss_hum_020_3_des: Increase Sweetie's movement speed, and decrease the movement speed of all nearby targets.
Boss_hum_020_4_des: Every 15 seconds, Sweetie randomly selects a target on the field to inflict massive damage every second for 15 seconds, prioritizing targets with Fortitude Resonance.
Boss_hum_020_2_des: Every 25 seconds, Sweetie casts Penalty on 2–4 random nearby targets. The targets will take damage if they engage in any actions within 5 seconds of receiving Penalty.
Boss_hum_009_3_des: Chiron the Centaur sprints more often.
Boss_hum_009_4_des: Chiron the Centaur's attacks ignore Hyperbody.
Boss_hum_009_5_des: Chiron the Centaur creates electromagnetic traps around itself, stunning those who step on them for 3s.
Boss_030_5_des: Rudolph enters Rampage Mode, greatly increasing its movement speed.
Boss_030_3_des: Rudolph receives a massive damage reduction from the front, but its damage taken from behind is increased.
Boss_030_4_des: Rudolph activates a wide-area Phantasia for 5 seconds at set intervals.
Boss_hum_64_4_des: Xingtian has a chance to significantly reduce the movement speed of non-Fortitude targets for 4s when hitting them.
Boss_hum_64_3_des: Xingtian deals significantly increased damage to targets with a higher HP ratio than himself.
Boss_hum_64_5_des: Xingtian significantly increases his movement speed.
Boss_hum_64_2_des: Xingtian deals damage once to nearby enemies and gains invicibility for 15s when HP drops below 25%. Triggers only once.
Boss_hum_086_2_des: Has a chance of gaining a Shield that blocks 1 instance of damage.
Boss_hum_086_1_des: Has a chance to stun enemies for 1.5s upon hit.
Boss_hum_086_4_des: Generates a large-scale explosion every 5s, dealing damage and reducing the target's Attack, Crit, or Resistance randomly for 5s.
Boss_hum_086_3_des: Grants an Attack Boost or Damage Reduction every 10s, lasting for 10s.
Boss_hum_062_5_des: Nan Yin negates the target's hyperbody for 10 seconds upon hit.
Boss_hum_062_2_des: Nan Yin's ATK increases over time. Successful counterattacks from enemies remove the ATK increased.
Boss_hum_062_3_des: Nan Yin stuns the selected target for 2 seconds every 5 seconds, ineffective against targets with Fortitude.
Boss_hum_062_4_des: Nan Yin gains additional Damage Reduction, but loses a large amount of HP if shattered.
Boss_hum_018_3_des: Gains temporary damage reduction for 5s when attacked. Cooldown: 15s.
Boss_hum_018_2_des: Spreads Corrosion, reducing damage dealt by nearby targets.
Boss_hum_018_4_des: Gains one stack of Vigor with each hit. At 10 stacks, the next attack deals massive bonus damage.
Boss_hum_046_5_des: Large random explosions will occur in the area, dealing lethal damage upon hit and leaving Infernal Flames in the area.
Boss_017_4_des: Greatly increase the movement speed of Frost Bot.
Boss_014_4_des: Greatly increase the movement speed of Apophis.
Boss_065_3_des: When Merbelle has a shield, gain additional damage reduction and greatly increase shield strength.
Boss_065_2_des: Whenever Merbelle loses a certain amount of HP, its attack will increase.
Boss_065_4_des: Each time Merbelle deals damage, inflicts a stack of Flashfreeze. When Flashfreeze stacks 15 times, stacks clear and the Wanderer is greatly slowed for 6 seconds.
Boss_065_5_des: Merbelle unleashes an ice pillar at a target every 15 seconds, dealing huge damage. The ice pillar remains on the field, restoring 3% of Merbelle's Max HP every 10 seconds. The ice pillar can be destroyed by multiple attacks.
Boss_hum_060_2_des: Forlorn Minister's attacks deal additional DMG based on the HP ratio. Cooldown: 3 seconds.
Boss_hum_060_4_des: Forlorn Minister temporarily gains increased movement speed.
Boss_hum_060_5_des: Forlorn Minister's shield becomes nearly unbreakable.
Boss_hum_060_3_des: Forlorn Minister periodically gains a brief period of invincibility.
Boss_hum_069_02_des: The Hive Mother has high Crit Resistance. If her defenses are shattered, her Crit Resistance will temporarily disappear.
Boss_hum_069_05_des: Every 15 seconds, the Hive Mother scans her surroundings. If Attack, Balance, Fortitude, and Benediction are not present at the same time, all of the Hive Mother's attacks will inflict lethal damage.
Boss_hum_069_04_des: Every 5 seconds, the Hive Mother inflicts lethal damage every second to the locked-on target for 5 seconds. If the target has Fortitude, this damage is significantly reduced.
Boss_hum_069_03_des: Upon entering battle, the Hive Mother will summon 2 Rampage Prisoners to assist in combat. The Prisoners are in an invincible state, and will die once the Hive Mother is defeated.
Boss_hum_025_2_des: Barbarossa gains Bleed upon hitting the targets, dealing damage equal to % of Max HP per second for 15s, up to 1 stack.
Boss_hum_025_3_des: Barbarossa enters Rampage Mode, greatly increasing its movement speed.
Boss_hum_025_5_des: Barbarossa inflicts Fear upon locking a target, greatly reducing their movement speed. The effect is halved against targets with Fortitude.
boss_hum_074_2_des: Prevents healing on targets hit by Phantasmic Scorpion for 10s.
boss_hum_074_4_des: Phantasmic Scorpion releases poisonous fog in a random area nearby every 10s, inflicting Slow on those who enter.
boss_hum_074_3_des: Phantasmic Scorpion releases a lethal poison in a large area every 30s.
Boss_hum_001_02_des: Aberrant Franken's shield cooldown is significantly reduced, but breaking the shield causes Aberrant Franken to lose more Max HP.
Boss_hum_001_03_des: Aberrant Franken's attacks trigger an earthquake, dealing damage and slowing affected targets.
Boss_hum_001_05_des: Aberrant Franken gains enormous bonus shield points, greatly reducing damage received while the shield is active.
Boss_hum_001_04_des: Aberrant Franken selects a player who gains 100% shatter rate. Others cannot damage his shield.
Boss_hum_019_4_des: Frigg enters Rampage Mode, greatly increasing her speed.
Boss_hum_019_3_des: Frigg gains a damage boost each time she lands a hit. This effect can stack.
Boss_hum_019_5_des: Frigg enters Extreme Mode, increasing her speed and leaving frost under her feet. If you touch the frost, you will take damage and be slowed, which can be stacked up to 3 times.
Boss_017_3_des: Frost Bot will repair itself, slowly recovering HP.
Boss_017_2_des: Frost Bot continuously generates Field generators around it. Each generator provides damage reduction to Frost Bot and can be shattered through multiple attacks.
Boss_017_5_des: Frost Bot releases a powerful chill around itself every second, continuously Slowing nearby targets.
boss_hum_079_2_des: Increases the Defender's speed for all actions.
boss_hum_079_4_des: Deploys a Radiation Bomb periodically that detonates after a 5-second delay, releasing radiation across a wide area and dealing lethal damage. Can be disarmed after hit multiple times.
boss_hum_079_3_des: Launches multiple missiles on the surrounding area periodically, dealing lethal damage.
boss_hum_079_5_des: Creates an invincible copy of itself, with all the Defender's Abilities, when its HP reaches 80%.
Boss_hum_046_2_des: Attacks come with a powerful Graying Bite effect. Increase corresponding elemental resistance or avoid being hit.
Boss_014_2_des: Attacks come with a powerful Graying Bite effect. Increase corresponding elemental resistance or avoid being hit.
Boss_hum_057_3_des: Zhuyan can be executed. Use weapons with high Shatter to break its shield and execute it.
Boss_hum_057_4_des: Zhuyan erupts the ground every 5s, dealing lethal damage and leaving pools of lava at the explosion sites.
Boss_hum_057_2_des: Zhuyan inflicts Brutality with each hit. At 5 stacks, it triggers an explosion that deals massive damage to target and nearby enemies.
Boss_hum_057_1_des: Zhuyan's attacks carry an additional Powerful Graying Bite effect. Increase corresponding elemental resistance or avoid being hit.
boss_012_3_des: The Singer constantly deals massive Radiation DMG to nearby enemies.
boss_012_4_des: The Singer summons a decoy every 30 seconds, becoming invincible while the decoy exists. Attack the decoy a set number of times to destroy it and dispel the Singer's Invincibility.
boss_012_5_des: Whenever dealing damage, the Singer inflicts a stack of Corruption, which, upon reaching 20 stacks, reduces the target's ATK and movement speed for 15 seconds.
boss_012_2_des: The Singer's attacks inflict Corrosion DMG.
boss_hum_074_5_des: Stone Pillars spawn around the Phantasmic Scorpion every 20s. 10s later, the Phantasmic Scorpion releases poison to all targets not sheltered by the pillars, inflicting an 8-second Stun on them.
Boss_hum_032_5_des: Valkyrie summons lightning bolts around it at regular intervals, dealing lethal damage and electrifying targets. When an electrified target is hit by a volt attack, chain lightning is triggered.
Boss_hum_059_3_des: Grants a shield at the start that breaks after 200 hits.
Boss_hum_059_4_des: Deals huge damage based on HP percentage to nearby targets.
Boss_hum_032_2_des: Increase speed of all of Valkyrie's actions.
Boss_hum_032_3_des: Valkyrie is immune to damage 1 time every second.
Boss_hum_032_4_des: Valkyrie leaves destructible electrodes on the ground around it at regular intervals. These electrodes periodically emit a circular electrical current in the surrounding area.
Boss_hum_042_3_des: Every 15 seconds, Gaia randomly selects a target. After 5 seconds, the selected target inflicts wide-area lethal damage every second to all allies except themselves for 5 seconds.
Boss_hum_042_2_des: Gaia inflicts Bonecrush on targets without Fortitude with each hit. At 20 stacks, the debuff triggers Cripple, massively reducing their damage dealt for 10 seconds.
Boss_hum_042_5_des: After Gaia's shield is shattered, it deals wide-area damage every second for 10 seconds. Targets hit will be inflicted with 15% weakness for 10 seconds, up to 3 stacks.
Boss_hum_036_5_des: In the final phase, Culton summons red pillars. Each pillar increases Culton's damage boost and damage reduction by 20%. Make Culton collide with the pillars to disable the buffs.
Boss_hum_036_4_des: Culton enters an invincible state for 3 seconds each time he loses a certain amount of HP.
Boss_hum_036_2_des: Culton triggers Hostility on the selected target every second. Each stack of Hostility slows the target for 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.
Boss_hum_036_3_des: For every 30 seconds, Culton induces chaos, reversing Wanderers' movement for 15 seconds.
Boss_002_3_des: Minotaur can be executed. Use weapons with high shatter to break its shield and execute it.
Boss_002_2_des: Minotaur significantly reduces damage received from the primary aggro target.
Boss_002_5_des: Every 15 seconds, Minotaur examines all Wanderers. If a Wanderer is found to be within 5 meters without any other Wanderers nearby, that Wanderer will lose their hyperbody and invincibility and will be unable to regain hyperbody or invincibility for 90 seconds.
Boss_002_4_des: Every 15 seconds, Minotaur randomly selects a target with Benediction, applying Toxicitea, which converts the target's healing into an equivalent amount of damage. Lasts for 10 seconds.
Boss_015_3_des: Sobek can be executed. Use weapons with high shatter to break its shield and execute it.
Boss_015_4_des: When Sobek hits a non-Fortitude target, it applies Vulnerability to the target for 10 seconds, stacking up to 10 times.
Boss_015_5_des: Sobek enters a frenzy state, greatly increasing all speeds.
Boss_015_2_des: When Sobek locks onto a target, their critical hit rate is significantly reduced.
Boss_hum_006_2_des: Robarg applies 1 stack of Neural Toxin on targets hit. Reaching 15 stacks Stuns the target for 15s. Neural Toxin stacks can be cleansed by picking up randomly dropped antidotes.
Boss_hum_006_4_des: Robarg becomes Invincible every time he loses 25% Max HP and generates 3 purple areas nearby. His Invincibility breaks when players stand in all 3 areas simultaneously.
Boss_hum_006_1_des: Robarg loses no more than 3.5% Max HP per second.
boss_047_2_des: Jormungand gains speed in all actions.
boss_047_4_des: Every 10 seconds, Jormungand fires a piercing light beam, dealing damage to all targets on the field.
boss_047_3_des: Jormungand instantly executes target with less than 20% health.
boss_047_5_des: There's a chance that Jormungand and nearby monsters won't take damage when attacked.
boss_hum_061_4_des: Ying Zhao randomly selects 3 targets to form a triangular link, becoming invincible. Only enemies enclosed within the triangle take damage.
boss_hum_061_3_des: Ying Zhao cannot be critically hit.
boss_hum_061_5_des: Ying Zhao unleashes damage taken over the past 3 seconds to nearby enemies every 15 seconds. This damage cannot be fatal.
boss_hum_061_2_des: Ying Zhao gains a shield every 20 seconds, capable of blocking up to 40 instances of damage.
Boss_hum_046_4_des: Gain the Infernal Flames skill. The majority of the boss's attacks will leave a large area on the ground that burns continuously. Avoid entering the burning areas.
Boss_hum_042_4_des: Targets hit by Gaia are slowed for 5 seconds, stacking up to 2 times.
Boss_010_5_des: When Seraph recevies lethal damage, it becomes invincible for 10 seconds. During that period, it continuously deals a huge amount of damage every second to the surrounding area. The trigger interval is 120 seconds.
Boss_010_3_des: After Seraph lands a hit on a target, it grants a HP shield to all its friendly units equal to 5% of their respective Max HP. The shield cannot be stacked and lasts for 3 seconds. The minimum trigger interval is 1 second.
Boss_010_4_des: After Seraph hits a non-Fortitude target, Punishments will be added. Punishments will be reduced by 1 stack every 5 seconds. If Punishment stacks reach 10, that Wanderer will lose their hyperbody and invincibility and will be unable to regain hyperbody or invincibility for 90 seconds.
Boss_010_2_des: Seraph's attacks carry an additional Powerful Graying Bite effect.
boss_hum_037_2_des: Iron Tomb's attacks have a certain chance to inflict a 5-second Countermove effect, disabling the target's hyperbody for its duration.
boss_hum_037_5_des: Every 20 seconds, Iron Tomb randomly links 2 players within range, reducing their final damage by 30%; each linked player provides a 30% increase in Iron Tomb's final damage. Moving away from Iron Tomb can break the link.
boss_hum_037_4_des: Every 8 seconds, Iron Tomb's attacks inflict a Maim effect, significantly reducing the damage dealt and healing received on non-Fortitude targets for 8 seconds.
boss_hum_037_3_des: Every 20 seconds, Iron Tomb gains damage reduction based on its Max HP lost for 20 seconds.
Boss_hum_075_3_des: Formation Point Sphere releases a pulse every 5s, sending electricity arcing between nearby targets. The current prioritizes bouncing to others before returning to you.
Boss_hum_075_5_des: Formation Point Sphere applies 1 stack of Paralysis with each hit. At 20 stacks, it forcibly paralyzes the target for 5s.
Boss_hum_075_2_des: Increases all Formation Point Spheres' speed.
Boss_hum_075_4_des: Formation Point Sphere leaves behind an electrified zone when it lands or slides, dealing Volt damage every second to enemies within the area.
Boss_hum_073_2_des: When Asurada hits targets, it reduces their Max HP for 10s, stacking up to 3 times.
Boss_hum_073_3_des: Asurada prevents targets hit from healing for a short period.
Boss_hum_073_4_des: Asurada's hits on non-Fortitude targets sear them, dealing damage based on a percentage of their Max HP every second for 10s, stacking up to 3 times.
Boss_hum_073_1_des: Asurada periodically gains damage reduction, which is removed when successfully countered.
Boss_hum_045_5_des: Abyssant: Eva gains Invincibility. A light circle appears nearby every 15s. Abyssant: Eva loses Invincibility for 30s once she steps into the circle.
Boss_hum_045_3_des: Abyssant: Eva deals massive damage, distributed among nearby enemies.
Boss_hum_045_2_des: Abyssant: Eva's Attacks inflict Graying Bite.
Boss_hum_045_4_des: When below 25% HP, Abyssant: Eva loses 5% of her Max HP per second and deals lethal damage over time to nearby enemies.
Boss_014_3_des: Apophis can be executed. Use weapons with high shatter to break its shield and execute it.
Boss_014_5_des: Nullify the hyperbody status of targets around Apophis.
Boss_hum_067_1_des: Grants Fei Lian 1 stack of Damage Reduction of an Element for 3s after getting hit with that Element. Grants up to 1 stack every second.
Boss_hum_067_4_des: Generates Elemental Ores every 15s around Fei Lian. The ores break upon 5 hits of the corresponding Elements but explode if they are not broken within 15s, dealing lethal damage to characters and healing Fei Lian.
Boss_hum_067_3_des: Owns 5 stacks of Element Shield, each stack reducing the damage Fei Lian takes. Elemental attacks remove the corresponding Shield for 10s.
Boss_hum_067_2_des: Ignores the target's resistances when attacking.
boss_007_5_des: Hyena Mecha frequently unleashes machine gun sweeps, with its range greatly increased.
boss_007_2_des: Hyena Mecha gains a 20% damage increase and one stack of Overheat with each attack. Upon reaching 5 Overheat stacks, it resets and restores a portion of its Max HP.
boss_007_4_des: Hyena Mecha disables the HP shields of surrounding targets every 20s, lasting 10s.
boss_007_3_des: Hyenatron's attacks ignore the target's resistance.
